fusions.name: Forking Brand
fusions.desc: Throws a brand that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets, then forks to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 80% of the original damage. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Two-Pronged Gout
fusions.desc: Looses 2 gouts of flame that split apart, each dealing 12 damage and setting the target [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Parted Flames
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is split off and sent back to whoever dealt it. You have 15% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 2. When you reach 2, they all spend at once: a second blow of flame strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (41% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
